_fixture_source: Labeled set for the scholar_search `verify --title` cutoff calibration (2026-10-02). Every DOI and every real title comes from an OpenAlex record returned by one of eight `find` calls into research/2026-10-02_FrameworkDev_ScholarlySearch/calibration_verify/ (MANIFEST.jsonl rows with command=find, DAAF_FETCH_CONTEXT=FrameworkDev_S1_verify_calibration); the W-id -> raw artifact map is calibration_verify/derived/candidates.parquet (scripts/01_extract_calibration_candidates.py). `record_title` is the title OpenAlex resolves the DOI to (confirmed against each item's own verify run by scripts/calibrate_verify_cutoffs.py). Variants are authored, not fetched: variant_source says how.
claimed_year_rule: claimed_year = OpenAlex publication_year of the work the claimed title comes from (provenance.claimed_from_wid: the other version or other paper; for X40 the 2013 original review) when there is one; otherwise (mechanical and model-authored variants, including fabricated titles that borrow the DOI's real author) the record's own publication_year, the year such a citation would most plausibly carry. record_year = publication_year of provenance.record_wid. Both from calibration_verify/derived/candidates.parquet (OpenAlex records of 2026-10-02); added 2026-10-03 by scripts/03_add_claimed_year_to_fixture.py.

label_rules.match: claimed_title plausibly denotes the SAME work as the DOI's record (same study, setting and design), however garbled.
label_rules.mismatch: claimed_title denotes a DIFFERENT work: another real paper, or an invented one whose setting, outcome, population or design differs from the record.

variant_source_values.mechanical: deterministic edit of the record's own title (subtitle dropped, suffix added, case/punctuation/diacritics/spelling changed, truncated)
variant_source_values.real-version-pair: the title of another real version of the same work (working paper vs journal, index glitch vs clean title), taken from its own OpenAlex record
variant_source_values.model-authored: written by the calibrating agent: an LLM-style garble of the real title (match) or a fabricated plausible title (mismatch)
variant_source_values.real-other-paper: the title of a different real paper, taken from its own OpenAlex record

title_separable_note: identical_title_other_work items carry the record's exact title on another work's DOI; no title metric can separate them, so the title-only confusion table excludes them and the calibration reports them separately. The cited year separates them (verify --year, R4, 2026-10-03): the title+year table and the no-mismatch-reaches-CONFIDENT test include X40, which grades WEAK.
